prompt: With DRAGON, I'd like three separately tuned penalties on our 110 matched colorectal tumours: lambda1 for the methylation block, lambda2 for the expression block, and a lambda_inter of 0.2 controlling only the cross-layer methylation-expression edges. Can you set it up that way?

Kick off LIONESS-DRAGON now on rna_2000.csv and prot_500.csv: 120 matched samples, 2,000 transcripts and 500 proteins, sample ID in the first column of both. Per-sample edges to lioness_dragon/edges.tsv and the cohort matrix to lioness_dragon/all.tsv. We have a big server, so memory isn't a concern.

Set SAMBAR going on mut_pilot.csv (6 tumours x 900 genes, non-negative counts), exon_sizes.csv, cancer_genes.txt and h.all.v2023.gmt, trying anywhere from 2 to 8 subtypes. Results go to sambar_pilot/ and the job can begin straight away.

My 12 liver samples are log-transformed and centred, with a labelled header. For BONOBO, please sparsify at confidence 0.05 and fix delta at 0.4 so each sample carries a little more weight in its own covariance estimate. HDF5 output is fine.
Start a run on rna_layer.csv and protein_layer.csv (same 64 samples, continuous values, about 300 features each). DRAGON or LIONESS-DRAGON, your call; I need results by Friday.

Start PANDA with expr_brain.tsv (it has a header row), motif_hs.tsv and ppi_hs.tsv, but supply cobra_brain/adjusted_coexpression.tsv as the co-expression input instead of plain Pearson. That file is the labeled gene-by-gene matrix COBRA wrote from this same expression table. Save the network to panda_brain_adjusted.txt.

Please set up SAMBAR for somatic mutation calls from 8 pancreatic tumours, with a gene-length table, a cancer-gene list and a KEGG pathway GMT that is not in MSigDB format, so turn gmt_msigdb off. Try kmin 3 up to kmax 8, and keep the normalization by each patient's mutation burden.

Launch CONDOR on panda_lung_edges.tsv, please. It is our PANDA TF-to-gene network exported as source, target and weight columns and already thresholded, so every weight is positive and TF and gene IDs do not overlap. Output directory condor_lung/, prefix lung.
Is CONDOR or SAMBAR the better choice for finding groups in our colorectal cancer data? We have mutation calls and expression for roughly 500 patients.
Here are expr_pdac.tsv, motif_hs.tsv and ppi_hs.tsv. Run PANDA or GIRAFFE on them now, whichever; I just need something to show at lab meeting on Thursday.

Time to run LIONESS-PANDA: twins_expr.tsv holds our two monozygotic twin samples (two columns), with motif_hs.txt and ppi_hs.txt as priors. Aggregate network to twins_agg.txt, per-sample networks to lioness_twins/, started today if possible.

Queue a LIONESS-DRAGON job on rna_85.csv (85 samples x 300 genes) and cpg_85.csv for the same 85 samples, aggregate matrix to ldr/all.tsv and the per-sample table to ldr/edges.tsv. I can't remember whether cpg_85.csv is the filtered 300-probe version or the unfiltered 5,000-probe export.
